title: Initiation
text: The network initiates the mobility from NR procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED, possibly in response to a MeasurementReport or an MCGFailureInformation message, by sending a MobilityFromNRCommand message.     The network applies the procedure as follows: a) the procedure is initiated    only when AS security has been activated,  and  SRB2 with at least one DRB are setup and not suspended;      b) the procedure is not initiated   if any DAPS bearer is configured;
